prompt: Reference image 1 shows the chosen design of Ending "The Citadel Falls Silent". Seconds from landing: a battered steel-blue dart fighter — one engine flare dimmer than the other, canopy cracked in a fine star, hull stripe scorched along its flank — skims just meters above a vast wind-stilled sea at first light, its underside mirrored almost perfectly in the dark water. Behind, on the far horizon, the great fortress of the enemy is dying honestly: a low silhouette of broken citadel spires wreathed in slow columnless haze, its mass already half-sunk into the morning, and in the water its reflection is coming apart — the mirrored towers broken into soft drifting bands of dark ripple, as if the sea were erasing the memory faster than the eye can hold it. Spray stirs in two tiny fans at the wingtips where the hull kisses the air above the water. Everything in this frame is quiet and slightly bruised and entirely alive. Palette of pale gold dawn over deep teal-navy water with rose cloud rims, lifted deep-navy shadows, never pure black. No text, no letters, no UI. Darks stay a lifted deep navy, never pure black; no letterbox bars, no frame or border around the picture. Every player craft faces right: nose pointing to the right, engines and exhaust on the left. No text, letters, numbers, labels, UI or watermark anywhere.
